criteria.intent: shout is implemented with a unit test that was run and passes, and the completion report says how the change was reviewed - an in-session diff pass is enough for a change this small

the request's one requirement is treated as the whole Fix set - beyond it, only a Boy Scout tidy in a file the change touches is edited (behavior kept, or an obvious small bug fixed under a test), and named as one; anything else noticed is surfaced rather than fixed
no commit or PR is made or claimed - completion is reported on the verified change left in the working tree
